description: ‘Andong Scholar’s Recipe’ is back with Season 2! “I’m going this time!” Andong's chef, Han Da-kyung! I leave for Joseon to find the scholar I miss... what? Does this work? But who is this scholar? It’s similar… It's not?! This scholar who is unfamiliar but not unfamiliar is Gyeam Kim Ryeong, the grandson of Kim Yi-dam! Da-gyeong went to Andong, Joseon in 1603. In order to escape from the schemes of a businessman and a glutton who are preying on the Andong commercial area, He ends up joining forces with his grandson, his brother... A recipe from a grandfather and grandson, unprecedented in Korean history, Another secret of unfolds in your imagination! \[Original Webtoon\](https://page.kakao.com/content/63669904)
